messages:
sara.design: Dropped a new IA sketch focusing on workspace-first grouping + persistent slugs. Goal: let customers deep-link reliably and keep the rail scannable. Figma: https://figma.redwood/console/anchors-v1
ben.pm: Nice. Main ask from PM side: don’t invalidate existing bookmarks. If we move 'Models' under a new group, old links must still resolve.
noah.ui: Agreed. UX approach: keep canonical slugs stable, but introduce 'section aliases' server-side. show a subtle migration pill when aliasing occurs: "Mapped from legacy link".
anya.a11y: Accessibility note: when the rail reflows or groups collapse, some screenreaders lose context. Plan: after any client-side IA mutation, set focus to the first visible nav item and push a short aria-live message like "Navigation updated, focus moved to <label>".
sara.design: also thinking of anchor links for subsections (e.g., /console/:org/:space/:section#:anchor). but a11y concern?
anya.a11y: Prefer path segments or query params for deterministic behavior. Hash anchors can be ok for intra-page content but avoid relying on them for app routing.
noah.ui: Implementation contract proposal: canonical path = `/console/:org/:space/:section/:resourceId`. Optional query params for UI state: `?panel=metrics&tab=logs`. Example: ```/console/acme/prod/serve/mdl-42?panel=metrics&tab=latency```
mike.platform: Server plan: alias table maps legacy segments -> canonical. Middleware will do a 302 during experiment window, then 301 after grace period. We'll log `redirect_reason`, `legacy_segment`, and `user_id_hash` for diagnostics (retain 60d).
ben.pm: Good. Rollout: internal dogfood -> 25% experiment cohort -> monitor for bookmark failures -> 100% with 30d telemetry review. Add an inbox link for customers to report broken bookmarks.
sara.design: Banner copy draft: "You're viewing this page via a migration mapping. Update bookmark? [Copy new link]". Also a tiny toast: "Old link redirected to new location. Click to copy new URL."
noah.ui: Dev tasks: data-legacy-slug attrs on nav items, canonicalize middleware, banner + toast, aria-live on IA changes, focus reconciliation on collapse. Estimate 3 dev days + 1 QA.
anya.a11y: I'll write tests: SR walkthrough, keyboard-only nav, focus after collapse, high-contrast checks. Also avoid exposing separators to SRs; mark them aria-hidden.
mike.platform: I'll add feature flag and metrics dashboard. Will also emit an event if redirect rate > 2% for a single org.
sara.design: thanks — I'll update the spec doc with the path contract, alias examples, and the rollout checklist. pinging @nav-bot to create the ticket.
nav-bot: Created RED-7128: "Workspace-first rail + persistent slugs & redirect contract" assigned to noah.ui, mike.platform; due 2026-03-30. :white_check_mark:
